title: Graphic Designer
description:
**WE ARE HIRING!** 



* **Position:** 
 Graphic Designer – 2D Artist / 3D Artist
* **Location:** 
 Kolkata (Full\-time, Office\-based)
* **Joining Timeline:** 
 Immediate



  




**About Navkrit Brand Solutions** 

 Navkrit Brand Solutions is a full\-service brand strategy and creative agency dedicated to transforming brands through innovative design, strategic thinking, and compelling visual storytelling. We work across branding, experiential marketing, digital communications, and immersive design—helping brands create meaningful connections with their audiences. Our work spans both traditional and cutting\-edge visual mediums, from brand identity and print collateral to advanced 3D visualizations and digital experiences.
 



  




**The Role** 

 We're seeking talented Graphic Designers to join our creative team and bring brands to life through exceptional visual design. Whether you specialize in 2D design or 3D visualization, you'll work on diverse, high\-impact projects that challenge your creativity and expand your skillset. Our designers work collaboratively with strategists, marketing teams, and clients to transform brand concepts into compelling visual narratives that resonate across multiple platforms and formats.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 
* Translate creative briefs and strategic concepts into visually compelling designs
* Develop design solutions that align with client brand objectives and target audiences
* Maintain design consistency and quality across all deliverables
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (strategy, marketing, account management)
* Incorporate feedback and iterate on designs to achieve excellence
* Stay current with design trends while maintaining timeless, strategic thinking
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines
* Prepare deliverables in appropriate formats for various mediums (digital, print, web, interactive)
* Problem\-solve creative and technical challenges proactively



  




**2D Graphic Designer** 
 Role\-Specific Responsibilities
 * Design and develop cohesive brand identities (logos, brand guidelines, color systems, typography)
* Create engaging social media graphics and digital assets for multiple platforms
* Produce print collateral (brochures, packaging, banners, posters, presentations)
* Design web and digital interfaces with strong visual hierarchy
* Develop marketing materials and campaign graphics
* Ensure visual consistency across all touchpoints and formats



  




 Technical Skills
 * Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
* Experience designing for multiple formats (print, digital, web, social)
* Understanding of web design and responsive layouts
* Familiarity with file preparation for print and digital production



  




**3D Graphic Designer** 
 Role\-Specific Responsibilities
 * Create high\-quality 3D models and renderings of branding elements and products
* Develop 3D visualizations for brand presentations and marketing campaigns
* Design immersive 3D digital assets for web, social media, and interactive experiences
* Apply advanced texturing, lighting, and rendering techniques
* Produce photorealistic or stylized renders based on project requirements
* Optimize 3D assets for different platforms and devices
* Collaborate with 2D designers to ensure visual integration across mediums


**Technical Skills** 
* Proficiency in 3D modeling software (Blender, Cinema 4D, Maya, or similar)
* Strong understanding of 3D modeling, UV mapping, texturing, and lighting
* Experience with rendering engines
* Competency in Adobe Creative Suite (for post\-production and integration)
* Ability to deliver photorealistic or stylised renders



  




**What We Are Looking For** 
* Strong creative thinking with ability to conceptualize and execute original ideas
* Excellent eye for design principles (typography, color theory, composition, visual hierarchy)
* Ability to translate briefs into strategic visual solutions
* Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Time management and ability to handle multiple projects
* Self\-motivated learner with willingness to grow



  




**Education And Qualification** 

 We prioritize portfolio over credentials. Show us your best work!
 


* Formal education in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Effects, or related field is a plus
* Relevant experience through: Professional roles
* Internships
* Freelance projects
* Personal projects demonstrating skill and creativity
* Certification courses



  




**What Makes You Stand Out** 
* Portfolio that demonstrates both technical skill and strategic thinking
* Ability to understand client objectives and translate them visually
* Proactive problem\-solver who takes ownership
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work in team settings
* Passion for learning and staying updated with industry tools
* Ability to work across diverse design aesthetics and brand voices
* Understanding of how design serves business goals
* Initiative to explore new tools and techniques



  




**Why Join Navkrit Brand Solutions:** 
* **Diverse Projects:** 
 Work on high\-impact brand projects across multiple industries
* **Collaborative Culture:** 
 Work alongside strategists, creatives, and talented professionals
* **Growth Opportunities:** 
 Professional development and skill expansion
* **Modern Tools:** 
 Access to industry\-standard software and technology
* **Strategic Thinking:** 
 Be part of a team that values both craft excellence and strategic outcomes
* **Visibility:** 
 Your work impacts real brands and reaches real audiences
* **Learning Environment:** 
 Flexible hierarchy where great ideas are valued regardless of experience level



  





 We can't wait to see what you create. Apply now and let your portfolio do the talking!
 



 Know a talented 2D or 3D designer? Share this with them! We'd love to connect with passionate creatives.

description:

 🎨📱

 — someone who loves great design, understands social media, and can bring a concept to life from
 **idea → shoot → final post** 
 .
 



 📍
 **Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



 💼
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time

 **Design for Social** 




 Create engaging posts, carousels, stories, reels, thumbnails and campaign creatives across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook \& more.
 



 💡

 Come up with fresh, platform\-first ideas for social media campaigns, brand content and creative shoots.
 



 🎬

 Develop visual concepts, moodboards, shot ideas and creative directions for photoshoots and video content.
 



 📸

 Translate brand identities and campaign ideas into content that feels distinctive, relevant and visually compelling.
 



 🔥

 Keep up with social trends, formats, visual styles, memes and what’s actually getting people to stop scrolling.
 



 🤝
 **Collaborate \& Create** 




 Work closely with the content, strategy and marketing teams to turn briefs into ideas that people want to see, share and engage with.
 



  




 What we’re looking for:
 
 ✨ Strong sense of
 **design, aesthetics and visual storytelling** 




 🎨 Proficiency in
 **Adobe Creative Suite** 
 — Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, etc.
 



 📱 A strong understanding of
 **social media formats and content trends** 




 📸 Ability to think beyond static design and contribute to
 **shoot concepts and visual direction** 




 💡 Someone who can take a brief and bring their
 **own creative thinking** 
 to it
 



 ⚡ Comfortable with quick turnarounds and multiple projects

**Most importantly:** 
 We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just ask
 *“What do we need to design?”*

 If that sounds like you,
 **we’d love to hear from you.** 




 📩
 **Send us your CV \+ portfolio at design.trishagm@gmail.com**

title: Junior Designer
description:
Junior Designer @ Shizz
 



**0–2 years \| Full\-time \| Kolkata** 




  





 We’re looking for someone who makes things look 👌
 



 Shizz is a digital agency working with brands across D2C, FMCG, beauty, food, lifestyle and everything in between.
 



 We’re looking for a 
 **Junior Designer** 
  who gets excited about good design, has an unhealthy amount of Pinterest/Instagram saved posts and can turn a random brief into something people actually want to look at.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 



* Designing 
 **social media posts, carousels, stories \& ads** 
  that don't look like every other brand on Instagram.
* Turning creative ideas into scroll\-stopping visuals.
* Working on 
 **campaigns, launches, brand identities and digital content** 
 .
* Taking one design and making it work across 17 different formats because Instagram apparently needs that.
* Creating pitch decks and presentations that clients actually enjoy looking at.
* Working closely with our 
 **creative, strategy, copy and account teams** 
 .
* Bringing references, ideas, trends and "wait, hear me out..." concepts to the table.
* Taking feedback, making changes, questioning feedback occasionally, and making the work better.
* Keeping an eye on what's happening in 
 **design, advertising, culture and the internet** 
 .



  





**You should probably apply if...** 



* You have 
 **0–2 years of experience** 
  in graphic design, or you're a fresher with a killer portfolio.
* You know your way around 
 **Photoshop \& Illustrator** 
 .
* Bonus points if you know After Effects / Premiere Pro.
* You understand typography, composition, colour and visual hierarchy.
* You can make things look good 
 **without making them unnecessarily complicated** 
 .
* You have an eye for detail. Yes, that means noticing when things are 2 pixels off.
* You can handle multiple briefs without your laptop becoming a crime scene.
* You’re curious, proactive and actually want to get better at what you do.



  





**Extra points if...You:** 



* Know the difference between 
 **good design and design that just has a lot going on** 
 .
* Have strong opinions about fonts.
* Follow interesting brands instead of just design pages.
* Can explain 
 *why* 
  something works, not just that it "looks cool".
* Have a portfolio that makes us stop scrolling.
* Occasionally see an ad and think, 
 **"I could've made that better."**



  





**What Shizz is like** 




 You won't be sitting around making the same banner 47 times a day.
 



 You'll work across 
 **different brands, industries, briefs and creative challenges** 
 , and you'll get to see your work actually go out into the world.
 



 You'll work with strategists, copywriters, creatives and marketers. So you'll learn much more than just design.
 



  





**If you are a person who can get Shizz done, we would love to hear from you.**

title: UI UX Designer
description:
We are looking out for folks who are deeply passionate about working with tech Startups. If you live and breathe UX, this role is for you. As an
 **Senior UI UX Designer** 
 at Tech Exactly, you will get opportunities to work on great products (Mobile Apps \& Web Apps) from some of the smartest founders from around the world.
 



  





 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐨 \-
 


* Interact with prospects and understand their business goals.
* Research \& Create user personas, user journey, and information architecture to lay foundation for top notch product experience.
* You would also have to present your research to the client.
* Create a low \& high fidelity wireframe during the pre\-sales and post\-sales phase to help clients understand the user journey.
* You would be required to guide the development team about the user journey.
* You will also be expected to design high quality user interfaces and get those approved from clients.
* You will also be expected to ensure the development team has all the design assets as and when they need it.
* You’d have to ensure the design handoff to the development team is smooth and there are no gaps in the handoff.
* You’ll have to closely review the development builds and provide feedback to ensure your UX/UI recommendations are adhered to.



  





 𝐑𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞, 𝐬𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐬 \-
 


* Excellent English communication skills both written and spoken is a must for this role.
* Should have very strong analytical skills.
* Should be confident, organized, humble, patient, soft spoken, quick learner and most importantly driven to excel.
* Should have 4\+ experience doing UX/UI for Mobile App Development projects.
* Should understand Human interface guidelines.
* Should have basic knowledge on the app development process.
* Ability to come up with new concepts and help clients innovate is a big value add.
* Should have solid hands on experience with Figma.
* Should have design thinking.
* Knowledge in scrum will make your application stronger.

title: GIG-Customer tech-Adobe-Shopify-Front-EndDeveloper
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Shopify Front\-End Senior Developer**
**Experience:**
* Min 5 years of hands\-on experience


**Responsibilities:**
* Develop, customise, and maintain Shopify Online Store 2\.0 themes and storefront components.
* Build responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces following modern front\-end development standards.
* Develop customer journey experiences across key commerce touchpoints including product discovery, cart, checkout, and account management.
* Integrate third\-party applications and services into the Shopify storefront.
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate Figma designs into production\-ready Shopify experiences.
* Configure multilingual storefront experiences, including English and French language support.
* Implement brand design systems, including typography, colours, spacing, and reusable UI components.
* Support catalogue migration, content migration, and storefront launch activities.
* Implement and validate GA4 and GTM tracking requirements, including Shopify data\-layer configuration.
* Participate in sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, demos, and Agile ceremonies.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects and technical leads to identify implementation approaches and resolve technical challenges


**Skillset:**
* Shopify
* Shopify Online Store 2\.0
* Shopify Liquid templating language
* Shopify Theme Development and Customisation
* Shopify Theme Architecture
* Shopify Store Configuration
* Shopify Metafields and Metaobjects
* Shopify App Integrations
* Shopify CLI
* Front\-End Development
* HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScrit
* Responsive and mobile first development
* Understanding of accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design
* Git / GitHub / Azure DevOps
* GitHub Copilot and other AI accelerators for process and coding
* Knowledge of interface and visual testing processes
* Component\-based UI development
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) / Google Tag Manager (GTM)


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Packaging Graphic Designer
description:
We’re hiring a
 **Packaging \& Graphic Design Intern** 
 at Sequoia Print.
 



  





**Company Description** 




 Sequoia Print is a packaging prototyping and printing studio based in Kolkata. We work with brands and startups to develop thoughtful, high\-quality packaging by combining design exploration with advanced printing techniques.
 



 Our work sits at the intersection of design, print, materials, and packaging innovation.
 



  





**We are looking for a Packaging \& Graphic Design Intern who enjoys exploring creative ideas and translating them into visual layouts and mockups.** 




  





**The kind of work you’ll be doing:** 




 • Packaging concepts for internal brands
 



 • Full packaging layouts for monocartons and cartons
 



 • Typography and color explorations
 



 • Creating multiple visual routes for the same SKU
 



 • Packaging mockups and print\-ready explorations
 



  





**What matters is:** 




 • Strong graphic design sensibility
 



 • Curiosity towards packaging and materials
 



 • Ability to create complete packaging layouts
 



 • Good typography and composition skills
 



 • Interest in branding, print, and packaging systems
 



  





**If you know how to work with dielines/basic packaging dimensions, that’s a big plus.** 




  





 If this sounds interesting to you, please send across:
 



 • Your portfolio / Behance / Instagram
 



 • A few packaging projects or layout works
 



 • Your availability to start
 



 Email: business@sequoia\-print.com

title: Intern- Instructional Designer
description:
We are looking for enthusiastic fresh graduates who are interested in E\-Learning and Instructional Designing and want to begin their career in this field.
 



  





 As an Instructional Designer Intern, you will get hands\-on experience in creating engaging learning content, developing instructional materials, and understanding the fundamentals of E\-Learning and Instructional Design.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Assist in designing and developing E\-Learning content and learning materials.
* Create and structure content based on learning objectives.
* Work on storyboards, course outlines, scripts, and instructional materials.
* Collaborate with the E\-Learning team on real\-world projects.
* Research and learn different Instructional Design methodologies.
* Incorporate feedback and improve learning content.



  





**Who Can Apply?** 



* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in Instructional Designing/E\-Learning.
* Strong interest in learning and developing E\-Learning content.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Creative mindset with attention to detail.



  





**What You’ll Gain** 



* Hands\-on experience in Instructional Designing and E\-Learning.
* Exposure to real\-world E\-Learning projects.
* Guidance and mentorship from the E\-Learning team.
* Understanding of industry practices and Instructional Design methodologies.
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion of the internship.
* A strong foundation to begin your career in Instructional Designing.



  





 If you have an interest in E\-Learning and want to start your career in Instructional Designing, this opportunity is for you!
